name: assist-problem
description: Help desk problem section: centred heading over a fixed 606x400 art frame (blurred backdrop, ring, the panda, the UrsaAI orb and floating feature chips) beside a copy column with a sub-heading, paragraphs and bullets. Below 701px the copy moves above the frame, which scales as one piece. Live: .epx-prob on /solutions/help-desk-ticketing/ (rules ported).

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

sub_title.description: Copy-column heading. Line breaks are kept; "UrsaAI" renders as the brand mark.

body.description: Copy paragraphs, one per line. "UrsaAI" renders as the brand mark.

bullets.description: Bullet list under the paragraphs. Each: text (a plain string also works).

blur.description: Blurred backdrop image of the art frame (live 672x470, placed at -33,-33; hidden below 701px).

ring.description: Ring artwork, drawn behind the panda (595x397) and again inside the orb (232x155).

panda.description: Panda image (live 610x407, shown through a 259x276 window).

orb.description: Image inside the UrsaAI orb (live 144x100, cropped to an 80px circle window).

chips.description: Floating feature chips on the art frame. Each: label; optional icon_svg; x, y (px in the 606x400 frame), w (px width); mx, my (px position below 701px, defaults to x/y). The first four get staggered entrances.
